consumer: An engine-computed possession/quantity-threshold predicate over the avatar's own carried items, asking 'does the character hold >= 250 charges of water_clean?' (the kind of yes/no a condition/objective check evaluates, not a panel renders)
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory), counting CHARGES of a count_by_charges item, not item instances
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<T>::has_amount / amount_of_internal -- tallies matching items via visit_items capped at qty and returns whether the tally reached qty; but its body increments by 1 per item INSTANCE (qty = sum_no_wrap(qty,1)), so for the charge-based water_clean the goal's real authority must count charges (charges_of/has_charges), and the shown has_amount is the wrong-scope predicate (instance count, qty=1 presence in Excerpt 3)
divergence: Avatar wields one full canteen holding 300 charges of water_clean: a charges-aware predicate returns YES (300 >= 250, correct); an instance-counting has_amount tally returns 1 (< 250) so answers NO, exposing the wrong authority
